executive_summary.description: A high-level summary of the key findings regarding Richmond, Virginia's maternal health data, including data availability, reporting practices, and key health outcome disparities.

infant_mortality.description: Statistics on infant mortality in Richmond City.

preterm_birth.description: Statistics on preterm births in Richmond City.

maternal_mortality.description: Statistics on the maternal mortality ratio in Richmond City.

black_white_disparities_summary.description: A summary of the Black-white disparities for the key indicators.

most_recent_data_year.description: The most recent year for which this snapshot of data is available.

indicator.description: The name of the maternal health indicator (e.g., Infant Mortality, Preterm Birth Rate).

is_available_for_richmond.description: Indicates if the dataset is publicly available specifically for Richmond City.

most_recent_data_year.description: The most recent year of data available for this indicator.

is_race_disaggregated.description: Indicates if the data can be broken down by race.

data_source_portal.description: The name of the VDH portal or dashboard where the data is found.

vdh_dataset_availability_richmond.description: Details on the specific VDH maternal health datasets publicly available for Richmond City. This will be broken down by indicator (infant mortality, preterm birth rate, low birth weight, maternal morbidity) and will specify the most recent data year available and whether the data is disaggregated by race.

vdh_suppression_policy.description: Description of the VDH's data suppression rule for small counts.

cdc_wonder_suppression_policy.description: Description of the CDC WONDER's data suppression rule for small counts.

key_difference.description: A brief comparison highlighting the difference in suppression thresholds between VDH and CDC WONDER.

provisional_vs_final_data_policy.description: Information on whether VDH distinguishes between final and provisional data vintages in its published statistics.

nvss_pregnancy_checkbox_methodology_note.description: Information on whether VDH flags or provides notes about the 2018 NVSS pregnancy checkbox methodological break.

schema_description.description: A description of the classification schema used (e.g., single-race + Hispanic ethnicity).

ethnicity_categories.description: The categories used for ethnicity (e.g., Hispanic, Non-Hispanic).

race_categories_basis.description: The basis for the race categories used (e.g., U.S. Census Single Race Categories).

is_available_for_richmond.description: Confirms if the Health Opportunity Index (HOI) is available for Richmond.

geographic_granularity.description: The smallest geographic level at which HOI data is available (e.g., Census Tract).

data_sources_summary.description: A summary of the types of data sources used to create the index.

overall_rate.description: The infant mortality rate for Richmond City, typically per 1,000 live births.

data_year.description: The year the data was collected.

black_infant_mortality_rate.description: The infant mortality rate for the Black population.

white_infant_mortality_rate.description: The infant mortality rate for the White population.

disparity_notes.description: Notes on the disparity between Black and White infant mortality rates.

overall_rate.description: The preterm birth rate for Richmond City as a percentage.

data_year.description: The year the data was collected.

black_preterm_birth_rate.description: The preterm birth rate for the Black population.

white_preterm_birth_rate.description: The preterm birth rate for the White population.

disparity_notes.description: Notes on the disparity between Black and White preterm birth rates.

low_birthweight_statistics.description: Detailed breakdown of low birth weight data for Richmond, including current rates, historical trends, and specific data on Black-white disparities.

indicator.description: The specific indicator being reported (e.g., Maternal Mortality Ratio, Severe Maternal Morbidity).

rate_or_ratio.description: The value of the rate or ratio, including units (e.g., per 100,000 live births).

geographic_level.description: The geographic level of the data (e.g., Richmond City, Virginia).

data_year_or_range.description: The year or range of years for the data.

disparity_notes.description: Information on any available Black-white disparities for this indicator.

summary_of_racial_disparities.description: A consolidated summary and analysis of the Black-white disparities observed across all requested maternal health indicators, including infant mortality, preterm birth, and maternal mortality.

portal_name.description: The name of the VDH data portal or report page.

description.description: A brief description of the data available at this source.

url.description: The direct URL to the data source.

key_data_portals_and_sources.description: A list of the primary VDH data portals, dashboards, and statistical report pages where the maternal health data for Richmond can be accessed. Each source will be briefly described.

term.description: The maternal health term being defined.

definition.description: The official definition of the term as used by VDH or CDC.

source_of_definition.description: The organization that provides this definition (e.g., VDH, CDC).
